{{Top|leg}}
The '''Boreali Holotheater''' was a theater located in the upper levels of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It had a clear view of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Etain Tur-Mukan]] stopped there during her attempt to escape Coruscant during [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]].<ref name="o66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>
